title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Ninne Preethisuve
desc: A soldier dies in a war after he gets engaged to Meghamala. When she learns that his eyes were donated to another man, a sudden turn of events changes her life forever.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Shravana Banthu
desc: Kailash and Urvashi's relationship remains unfulfilled due to a tragedy in their past lives. Years later, Kailash's friend Vishwas tries to reunite the lovers in their present births.
